args.title: In handleClick, use a .catch/.finally (or try/catch) around exportReport
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In handleClick, use a .catch/.finally (or try/catch) around exportReport so that setBusy(false) runs even when the export promise rejects, and show an error toast instead of leaving the button disabled.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
handleClick calls exportReport(reportId, format).then(() => { setBusy(false); ... }) with no catch/finally; exportReport throws on non-2xx responses, so on failure the promise rejects, setBusy(false) never runs, and the button (disabled={busy}) stays greyed out until reload.
